candidate_manifest.scope: Generic byte-budget chunks; reused converted workspace; kernel writes final gradient slices directly. Raw dO preserved for delta. No shape whitelist or changed default package.

scope: Operator-level inference and first-order Q/K/V/bias2 gradients plus one SGD update. Synthetic operands repeat one seeded group N times; dimensions match model shapes, activations are not model captures. Scale=1, all keys valid. H100 fixed_* are custom kernels, not native. No raw tensors persisted.

training.gold: CPU FP64 forward/backward; one-round FP32 updated parameters

timing.includes: Public entry, CUDA events and synchronized wall; full forward/backward/SGD for training
timing.order: Alternating forward and reversed mode order across repetitions

cases.rng: NumPy PCG64 integer generation on CPU; no GPU RNG
